about: Stamps v3 goldens (B character, the bright palette, owner 2026-10-19). draw[id][tier] is the element list the kit draws at that tier (kit/lib.mjs tierSVG at xs 20, s 30, l 40), bottom to top, with the colours LITERAL as the SVG paints them; every renderer resolves data/stamp-art-v3 roles (hex = stamps.ts color, ink #1E1B35, tint = mix(hex, white, 0.88) half up) and its tier rule and must produce exactly these lists: the same elements in the same order, geometry verbatim, fill/stroke (null = none) and stroke width (0 = none). Every stroke is round-capped and round-joined. Below 15pt nothing is drawn but a dot of the hex. An id with no drawing draws `unknown` (the frame alone) in its colour, or the fallback hex. Written by scripts/import-stamp-art-v3.mjs; checked by src/lib/stamp-v3.test.ts (RN), the web's test and scripts/stamp-frame-golden.swift.
